purpose: Revalidate the frozen 381-item Gov’t Mule inventory after reviewed-performer implementation, without changing original rules-version-7 evidence.

verification.media_scope: Current v3 media references compared; the original v7 artifact retains the successful 206 bounded audio request. No new media-body request was made in this v8 verification.

hash_definitions.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON; object keys sorted; no insignificant whitespace; Unicode characters unescaped; no trailing newline. Python json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":")).encode("utf-8").
hash_definitions.original_v7_file_bytes_sha256: Hash of the exact UTF-8 bytes of the original_v7_evidence_file, including its trailing newline.
hash_definitions.projection_sha256: Existing observation content_hash from ArchiveObservationProjector. The same retained hash was compared across the pre-v8, first-v8 and repeat-v8 rows.
hash_definitions.interpretation_without_rules_version_sha: Hash of persisted interpretation object with only RulesVersion removed. All other evidence, reason, selected-date and DateDetails fields were compared exactly.
hash_definitions.reference_sha256: Hash of {source_uuid,show_uuid,display_date,track_uuids,mp3_urls}; UUID and URL arrays follow v3 source sets/tracks response order. Fetch the named show, select the source, flatten sets[].tracks[] to reproduce. This is the same reference definition as the original v7 file.
hash_definitions.ordered_track_uuids_sha256: Hash of the ordered UUID-string array from v3 sets[].tracks[].uuid.
hash_definitions.ordered_mp3_urls_sha256: Hash of the corresponding v3 sets[].tracks[].mp3_url array.
hash_definitions.ordered_flac_urls_sha256: Hash of SQL source_tracks.flac_url values, including nulls, ordered by source_sets.index then set UUID, then track_position then track UUID.
hash_definitions.sql_identity_sha256: Hash of {item_identifier,source_uuid,show_uuid,display_date,artist_uuid,sets}; sets array ordered by index then UUID. Each set contains {uuid,index,tracks}; each ordered track contains {uuid,position,mp3_url,flac_url,is_orphaned}. Whole-array sql_identity_* hashes use these source objects ordered by item_identifier. Historical arrays were compared in the isolated catalog; only digests and stable references are retained here.
hash_definitions.items_sha256: Hash of this artifact items array using canonical_json; entirely recomputable from this file.
